name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
label: Quest
description: Rin'ji, a troll, has lost an axe and been captured in Quel'Danil Lodge, and begs for help to escape. Rin'ji knows that others may not like Rin'ji's kind…
intro: Rin'ji, a troll, has lost an axe and been captured in Quel'Danil Lodge, and begs for help to escape. Rin'ji knows that others may not like Rin'ji's kind, but promises something in return and mentions a secret hidden at the Overlook Cliffs.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This troll tablet must be the "secret" that Rin'ji was talking about.
Covered with strange markings, you can not decipher what the tablet says.
